title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin surges 9% to $78,160 as greed climbs to 72. Hashrate sits at 812.7 EH/s, locking in network strength during the move.

Asia session delivered steady bids with the mempool at 79,215 transactions and fees holding at just 3 sat/vB. Block 963,420 cleared without incident.

Watch for profit-taking pressure near 80k today. Any dip below 76k could accelerate if volume fails to expand. Momentum favors bulls but greed levels warrant tight stops.
